_comment: Isolated morale-recovery scenario (#657): single infantry unit, started already ROUTING via the scenario's starting_state field (no enemy ever on the field, so nothing can interfere), recovers morale in isolation and rallies back to IDLE. Mirrors test_morale_recovery_demo_scenario.gd's staging: morale is pinned low (1.0) so the recovery is gradual instead of an instant one-tick rally, and drill mode keeps the battle from declaring a false victory the moment it sees zero team-1 units. Each routed man runs for his own back edge at his own flee pace (SoldierFlightStep); the unit's position is the centroid of its men while it routs and while they pull up. It rallies near tick 355 (60 Hz dump basis) at full flight; each man then pulls up on his own at his braking rate, and the unit re-forms where they come to rest. The position expects read that centroid: (800.0, 80.95) at tick 300, in flight, and (800.0, -112.76) at tick 480, at rest, identical on seeds 0 to 4 (dense 2-tick FULL dumps, measured 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch). They were (800.0, 75.6) and (800.0, -120.0) when the position was the old flight's anchor, which the bottom-up flight removed (#1949): the centroid of men who each run and pull up on their own sits 5.4 and 7.2 wu from where that anchor stood. Camera frames the recovering unit from a close zoom to show individual soldier detail, panning to track the flee and arriving at the rally (tick 180, in this manifest's 30fps recording basis -- see demos/README.md's note on the two tick bases), then following the halt to where the block comes to rest (tick 240) and holding.
